prompt_meta.title: GA Safety + Coordination: Game Chat (participants only) + Block/Report + Moderation placeholders (API + Web + Mobile)

owner_actions.when: after STEP-0010 report is shared with ChatGPT
owner_actions.instruction: Approve chat rules (who can chat), block/report behavior, and moderation placeholders described in ops/SAFETY_RULES.md. Approval only; no execution.

step_objectives.goal: Deliver GA-ready coordination and safety by implementing participant-only Game Chat with abuse controls (block/report) and moderation-ready audit trails.
outcomes: Game Chat exists as a first-class feature tied to a Game (thread per game)
Only eligible users can read/send messages (approved participants + host; requested/waitlisted/denied cannot)
Users can block other users (blocked users cannot DM via game chat, and their messages are hidden/flagged per defined rule)
Users can report a message/user with reason codes and metadata for future moderation tools
Chat supports pagination (load older), basic rate limiting, and message validation
Web + Mobile chat UI exists and is localized KO/EN
Notification integration: new message creates store-only notification (optional but preferred; reuse existing notifications)
Docs exist so future: club chat, DMs, moderation dashboard can be added without redesign
constraints: No club chat or DMs in this step (game chat only).
No external services required (no Firebase, no third-party moderation API, no paid providers).
IDE chooses realtime mechanism (websocket vs polling) but must document tradeoffs and test strategy.
Keep data model auditable (who sent what, when, which game, deleted/edited flags).
definition_of_done: IDE ensures Docker/infra is running (auto-start if needed) and migrations applied
API endpoints exist for: list messages (paged), send message, delete own message (optional), and chat thread metadata
Permissions enforced server-side based on game participation state
Block system exists: block/unblock endpoints + enforcement in chat fetch/send
Report system exists: report message/user endpoint + persisted records
Web chat UI exists on game detail (or dedicated route), including send + list + load older
Mobile chat UI exists in game detail flow, including send + list + load older
Docs created/updated: ops/CHAT_MODEL.md, ops/SAFETY_RULES.md, ops/MODERATION_PLACEHOLDERS.md, ops/API_CONTRACTS.md updated

deliverables_outcomes.goal: No owner execution; infra must be up for DB-backed chat.
requirements: Ensure Docker daemon is running (auto-start/install attempt as needed).
Ensure infra containers are up (compose up if needed).
Apply DB migrations required for chat/safety models.
acceptance_criteria: Report includes docker info + compose ps evidence (if used)

deliverables_outcomes.goal: A durable, auditable message model for GA.
requirements: Thread is tied to Game (1 game = 1 thread).
Message includes: id, gameId, senderId, body, createdAt, (optional) deletedAt or isDeleted flag.
Support pagination strategy (cursor preferred) and stable ordering.
Basic anti-abuse constraints: max length, empty disallowed, server-side validation.
acceptance_criteria: Docs define message schema, pagination, and retention assumptions
API tests validate ordering and pagination correctness

requirements: Approved participants + host can read and send.
Users in REQUESTED / WAITLIST / DENIED states cannot read/send.
If game CANCELLED, behavior must be defined (read-only or disabled) and enforced consistently; document rule.
acceptance_criteria: API tests cover all states and reject unauthorized access
Web/Mobile UI reflects rule (e.g., disabled composer)

requirements: Block/unblock endpoints exist.
Enforcement: IDE defines behavior and documents it (e.g., hide blocked user's messages by default; prevent sending if either side blocked).
Block system must work in game chat context.
acceptance_criteria: API tests cover blocking and resulting visibility/sending behavior

deliverables_outcomes.goal: Enable safe GA and future moderation tooling.
requirements: Users can report a message/user with reason code and free-text note (optional).
Persist report with metadata (reporterId, targetUserId, messageId optional, gameId, createdAt).
Moderation placeholders: define future admin review process in docs (no admin UI required now).
acceptance_criteria: API tests verify report creation and validation
Docs define reason codes and audit fields

requirements: Chat UI embedded in game detail or accessible from it.
Message list with pagination (load older) and timestamps; simple bubble layout.
Composer with send button; disabled state when not eligible.
Localization KO/EN for all visible strings.
acceptance_criteria: Web tests cover: renders chat, cannot send when not eligible, can send when eligible
Mobile tests cover: renders chat, can send flow mocked, pagination state handling headlessly

deliverables_outcomes.goal: Future-proof for club chat, DMs, FCM, moderation dashboards.
requirements: Create ops/CHAT_MODEL.md (schema, permissions, pagination, deletion behavior).
Create ops/SAFETY_RULES.md (block/report rules, edge cases, cancel rules).
Create ops/MODERATION_PLACEHOLDERS.md (future admin flows, data needed).
Update ops/API_CONTRACTS.md with new endpoints and errors.
acceptance_criteria: Tradeoffs clearly recorded (realtime vs polling, block behavior, cancellation behavior)

tasks.name: Ensure infra running (executor-owned)
tasks.objective: Auto-start Docker/infra and confirm DB connectivity.
acceptance: docker + infra running OR BLOCKED with exact OS/permission limitation

tasks.name: Chat models + migrations
tasks.objective: Add chat thread/message models and any required indexes/pagination strategy.
acceptance: migrations applied; model works in tests

tasks.name: API chat endpoints + tests
tasks.objective: List/send/delete(optional) messages with permissions enforced and pagination tested.
acceptance: API tests cover critical flows and edge states

tasks.name: Block/report endpoints + tests
tasks.objective: Implement block/unblock and report flows with enforcement.

tasks.name: Web + Mobile Chat UI
tasks.objective: Implement chat UI and integrate into game detail flow with localization.

tasks.name: Docs + manifest + report
tasks.objective: Write docs, update manifest, produce complete report.
acceptance: Docs complete; manifest updated; report complete

final_instruction_to_ide: Execute this prompt exactly. Do not delegate any execution to the owner. Choose implementation freely. Update ops/manifest.json and write a complete reports/STEP-0010.report.json with no placeholders.
